Check the status and retry. Development packages may retain the public version number; use their delivery notes to identify them.

Add one variable/operator/threshold => c: Add one variable/operator/threshold => color rule per line. Rules change the accent based on load, temperature and other values. Thresholds use the variable's original unit. Use valid color values; missing measurements are not treated as zero.
Add profiles to the queue and use Move U: Add profiles to the queue and use Move Up/Down to order them. Removing from the queue does not delete the profile. Automatic cycling advances at the configured interval. An empty queue uses the active profile; a single-item queue cannot switch to a different item.
Adjust the options specific to each prof: Adjust the options specific to each profile.
Aggregates: min, max, avg and sum. Range: Aggregates: min, max, avg and sum. Range/precision: clamp(value, min, max), round(value, digits), floor, ceil, abs and sign. Math: sqrt, pow, log, log10, exp, sin, cos and tan. percent(value, total) returns a percentage; between(value, min, max) tests an inclusive range.
All HUDs share one sampling interval; sh: All HUDs share one sampling interval; shorter intervals use more resources. Clocks update by seconds, while HTTP and balance sources keep their own refresh/cache intervals. Faster global sampling does not bypass a source's cache.
Always Visible keeps the HUD on screen w: Always Visible keeps the HUD on screen with an Always on Top or Desktop layer. With it off, power events, the mouse hot zone or trigger rules summon it temporarily, then retract it after the display duration. Turning off the Master Switch stops display for the session; the switch is re-enabled on the next app launch.

Export settings or create a backup under: Export settings or create a backup under About → Configuration & Maintenance. Import restores a complete setup. Back up before substantial edits. Secrets encrypted for the current user may need re-entry on a different machine or account.

Focus the shortcut box and press Ctrl or: Focus the shortcut box and press Ctrl or Alt with a letter, digit or function key, then Save & Apply. F12 and reserved combinations are rejected. If registration conflicts, the previous shortcut remains active. Clear and save to disable it.

Global Scale changes the whole HUD size;: Global Scale changes the whole HUD size; opacity controls its visibility. Font selection changes text rendering, with system fallback for missing glyphs. Display duration controls transient hold time; bounce and ripple controls change motion appearance. Reset Size & Animation restores this group of values; use Save & Apply afterwards.

Network profiles can use automatic byte: Network profiles can use automatic byte units or Mbps; 1 MB/s equals 8 Mbps. The ring compares total, download, upload or the larger direction with your reference bandwidth. The reference sets the 100% scale and does not limit or benchmark the network.
Once equivalent hardware fields are disc: Once equivalent hardware fields are discovered, duplicate legacy entries leave the library while existing profiles keep working. New keys identify a specific device and sensor. Highest/average summaries have different meanings and remain separate. -- means no valid value is currently available.
One CPU/GPU may expose package, core, ho: One CPU/GPU may expose package, core, hotspot, memory and multiple power channels. Similar names can represent different measurements. Sensor min/max values are session history, not hardware limits. SMBIOS module information comes from firmware and is not a complete SPD/XMP/EXPO timing table.
Open the config folder from the top bar: Open the config folder from the top bar and the logs folder from About. Keep source status or hardware diagnostics when troubleshooting. Reset loads first-run defaults; Save & Apply commits them to the running app.
Ordinary clocks use local time. World Cl: Ordinary clocks use local time. World Clock uses a fixed UTC offset without automatic DST. Daily-target mode shows the remaining fraction until the next target time in the chosen zone; with it off, it shows elapsed day progress.
Place the key in braces, followed by | a: Place the key in braces, followed by | and a display format. Use 0 for integers and 0.0 / 0.00 for fixed decimals. Literal text may surround tokens. Formatting changes display only.
Playing progress follows the reported ti: Playing progress follows the reported timeline and rate; paused timelines do not extrapolate. Live sessions without a duration have no valid percentage and show --. Players without registered sessions or missing artist/album metadata leave those fields unavailable.
Profiles, positions, queues, trigger rul: Profiles, positions, queues, trigger rules and hot zones belong to each instance. Clicking a HUD advances only its queue. Sampling interval, global shortcut and the click-cycling master setting are shared. Save & Apply commits the whole configuration.

Read the driver status at the top. If PawnIO is missing, install/update it and complete Windows UAC; fully exit ECP afterwards.
Restart ECP as administrator and check again. The restart button waits for the old process to exit.
If it remains unavailable, distinguish inaccessible-driver status from hardware returning no data, then export diagnostics.
Refresh and select a window/display targ: Refresh and select a window/display target, then set the full-scale FPS. Window FPS uses the process's dominant swap chain; display FPS uses its dominant presentation stream, not the fixed refresh rate. Missing events or permissions produce status information; administrator access may be needed. Ordinary GPU profiles can select an adapter, while raw sensor keys identify their stated device.
Request failed; check the network, URL a: Request failed; check the network, URL and credentials.
Save beside the profile records the edit: Save beside the profile records the edited profile; editing a built-in creates a custom copy. Preview shows the current edit. Save & Apply at the top right saves the full settings and applies them to the running HUD.

Search by name, key or category under Da: Search by name, key or category under Data Management → Variable Library. Select a variable to see its meaning, type, unit and formats. Copy Variable Key is useful for rings and rules; Copy Template includes braces for text fields.
Simple shortens the presentation; Full u: Simple shortens the presentation; Full uses the complete summon. Roll Up moves icons, values and the ring inside a persistent capsule while retaining its window and layer. Roll applies to persistent switches; initial and transient presentations keep their normal show/retract lifecycle. DeepSeek peak transitions keep Full animation.
Source names must be unique and use lett: Source names must be unique and use letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
Sources must be a JSON array.
Start from a built-in profile and Save t: Start from a built-in profile and Save to create a custom copy, or create a new profile. Delete removes custom profiles while original presets remain. Preview uses the current edit and real data; Save & Apply commits it to the running HUD.
Summon a HUD when data meets a rule.
Summon or temporarily hide the HUD.
Tagline, title, primary/secondary text a: Tagline, title, primary/secondary text and the right-side value can mix literal text and variable tokens. Use the right suffix for units such as %, °C or GHz. Icons identify the content; the accent color sets the capsule and ring color.
Targets may be hostnames, IPv4 or IPv6. ICMP ignores the port; TCP/UDP use it. Failure means that target/protocol did not respond successfully, not necessarily that the whole PC is offline. Servers may block ICMP or not reply to UDP.
The checkbox permanently silences only t: The checkbox permanently silences only the variables already listed in the current warning window. Other variables still warn. Closing normally acknowledges that incident. Multiple HUDs can share one warning window; expression faults are distinguished by profile and expression. Suppression does not repair or stop collection.
The response is not valid JSON.
The ring maps (value − minimum) over the: The ring maps (value − minimum) over the configured range, clamped to 0–100%. Use a variable key or a numeric expression beginning with =. Set a sensible full-scale value for temperature, traffic or FPS. The range does not change the raw text reading.
This structure is disabled. Replace the: This structure is disabled. Replace the URL with your real endpoint, adjust paths to the response and set enabled to true when ready. ${env:MY_API_KEY} reads a process environment variable instead of putting a secret directly in JSON.
